Coverage Indications, Limitations, and/or Medical Necessity

Covered Indications

The service will be considered reasonable and necessary when the following requirements are met:

  1. The patient has a documented diagnosis of the condition1; AND
  2. Conservative therapy has failed for at least six weeks.

Limitations

Use of the service for screening is not covered. Repeat services within 12 months are not covered.
